lines.x: ING reports that fast expansion in consumer and retail lending is supporting domestic demand in Kyrgyzstan, while lagging bank deposit growth raises liquidity and structural funding risks.
The Jogorku Kenesh adopted in first reading the draft republican budget for 2027, along with budgets for the Social Fund and the Compulsory Medical Insurance Fund, and amendments to the 2026 budget.
Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan and Tajikistan are preparing to launch a unified electricity market.

Gross domestic product in the Kyrgyz Republic reached 1.87 trillion soms ($21.4 billion) between January and October, advancing 10.5% year-on-year across industry and services, according to state statistics.
